steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/git
args:
set -euo pipefail
[[ "$$CI_SOURCE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ && "$$CI_CONTROL_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo 'Exact source and trusted control commit SHAs are required' >&2; exit 2; }
mkdir -p /workspace/source /workspace/control /workspace/results
cd /workspace/source
git init -q .
git remote add origin https://github.com/henryperkins/community-forums.git
git fetch -q --depth=1 origin "$$CI_SOURCE_SHA" "$$CI_CONTROL_SHA"
for file in Dockerfile run.sh package.py enforce.py upload.py; do
  git show "$$CI_CONTROL_SHA:deploy/cloudrun/browser-ci/$$file" > "/workspace/control/$$file"
done
git checkout -q "$$CI_SOURCE_SHA"

steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker
args:
set -uo pipefail
rm -f /workspace/runner-exit.json
docker build -f /workspace/control/Dockerfile -t retroboards-browser-ci /workspace/source/tests/browser
ci_runner_status=$$?
if ((ci_runner_status == 0)); then
docker run --rm --network host --shm-size=1g \
  --volume /workspace/source:/workspace/source --volume /workspace/results:/workspace/results \
  --volume /workspace/control:/workspace/control:ro --volume /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  --env CI_SOURCE_SHA --env CI_CONTROL_SHA \
  retroboards-browser-ci bash /workspace/control/run.sh
ci_runner_status=$$?
fi
printf '{"docker_exit_code":%s}\n' "$$ci_runner_status" > /workspace/runner-exit.json
exit "$$ci_runner_status"

steps.name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:slim
args:
set -euo pipefail
if [ ! -f /workspace/results/result.json ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"passed":false,"last_stage":"runner-startup","artifact_count":0}' > /workspace/results/result.json
fi
python3 /workspace/control/upload.py --results /workspace/results --outer-result /workspace/runner-exit.json --bucket "${_BUCKET}" --prefix "${_SHA}/$BUILD_ID"
